about: Generated by scripts/effect-docs.mjs from the effect registry (src/effects), the picker groups (src/effects/effectCatalogGroups.ts), the catalog text (src/services/nodeGraph/catalogText.ts) and the effect pages. Do not edit by hand: run node scripts/effect-docs.mjs. On a merge conflict, take either side and run it again.

effects.name: Brightness
effects.description: Lightens or darkens the mid-tones while black and white stay where they are.

effects.name: Contrast
effects.description: Adds punch: deeper shadows and brighter highlights on a soft S-shaped curve.

effects.name: Exposure
effects.description: Changes the amount of light like a camera's exposure: +1 doubles it, −1 halves it.

effects.name: Levels
effects.description: Chooses which tone becomes black, which becomes white and how bright the middle is.

effects.name: Saturation
effects.description: Makes colours stronger or weaker, from black and white to rich.

effects.name: Vibrance
effects.description: A gentler saturation that strengthens pale colours a lot and strong colours only a little.

effects.name: Temperature
effects.description: Makes the light warmer or cooler, like the white balance of a camera.

effects.name: Hue Shift
effects.description: Turns every colour around the colour wheel, so orange can become green and pink yellow.

effects.name: Invert
effects.description: Turns the picture into its negative: dark becomes light and every colour becomes its opposite.

effects.name: Posterize
effects.description: Reduces the picture to a few flat tones, like a screen print or a poster.

effects.name: Threshold
effects.description: Turns the picture into pure black and white at a brightness you choose.

effects.name: Box Blur
effects.description: Averages a square around every pixel, for a slightly hard, graphic softness.

effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.description: A smooth, even softening, like a lens out of focus.

effects.name: Motion Blur
effects.description: Smears the picture in one direction, as if the camera or the subject moved fast during the exposure.

effects.name: Radial Blur
effects.description: Blurs around a centre point: Zoom streaks the picture towards it, Spin turns it in circles.

effects.name: Zoom Blur
effects.description: Streaks the picture outward from a centre point, as if zooming in during the exposure.

effects.name: Sharpen
effects.description: Brings out detail and crisp edges in soft footage.

effects.name: Glow
effects.description: Makes the bright parts of the picture shine with a soft halo, like light blooming in a lens.

effects.name: Sheen
effects.description: A band of light that sweeps across the layer, the classic shine over a logo or a title.

effects.name: Vignette
effects.description: Darkens the edges and corners so the eye goes to the middle of the frame.

effects.name: Edge Detect
effects.description: Turns the picture into its outlines: bright lines where things meet, dark everywhere else.

effects.name: Acuarela
effects.description: Paints the picture as a watercolour, with flat washes of colour and the grain of the paper.

effects.name: Rom1
effects.description: Watery smoke: bright parts of the picture smear along slowly drifting currents.

effects.name: Color Wheel
effects.description: Paints a hue wheel: the colours go round the centre and reach full strength at the rim.

effects.name: Perspective Grid
effects.description: A glowing floor grid that runs to a vanishing point and scrolls towards the viewer: the classic retro stage floor.

effects.name: Stick Figure
effects.description: A posable stick figure for choreography sketches, storyboards and animated characters.

effects.name: Lens Correction
effects.description: Repairs what a camera lens does to a photo or clip: bowed lines, coloured fringes at contrast edges and dark corners.

effects.name: Guided Perspective
effects.description: Straightens buildings and walls that lean because the camera was tilted, from lines you draw in the Preview.

effects.name: AI Edge Fill
effects.description: Fills the empty borders left by lens and perspective corrections on a still photo with AI-made scenery.

effects.name: Fisheye Lens
effects.description: The rounded look of an ultra-wide fisheye lens: the middle comes closer and straight lines bend towards the edges.

effects.name: Bulge & Pinch
effects.description: Magnifies a round area like a lens bump, or squeezes it together.

effects.name: Twirl
effects.description: Turns the picture around a centre point: strongest in the middle, fading out to nothing at the edge of the area.

effects.name: Wave
effects.description: Ripples the picture with smooth waves, from a gentle ripple to a funhouse wobble.

effects.name: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Folds a slice of the picture into mirrored wedges around a centre, like looking through a kaleidoscope.

effects.name: Mirror
effects.description: Copies one half of the picture onto the other for perfect symmetry, with a seamless mirror line.

effects.name: RGB Split
effects.description: Shifts the red and blue colour layers apart, like a misprinted poster or a glitching screen.

effects.name: Crystal Glass
effects.description: Looks at the picture through cut glass: a grid of facets that each bend it a little.

effects.name: Glass Dispersion
effects.description: Splits the colours in small cells, as if seen through rippled glass.

effects.name: Film Prism
effects.description: Film shot through a cheap lens or a glass prism: edges gain soft rainbow fringes under a fine, living grain.

effects.name: Holo
effects.description: Lays a holographic foil over the picture: rainbow bands that bend with its tones.

effects.name: Pixelate
effects.description: Rebuilds the picture from squares, each in the average colour of what it covers.

effects.name: Block Mosaic
effects.description: Rebuilds the picture as a tiled wall: small tiles mixed with larger ones, separated by grout lines.

effects.name: Blockify
effects.description: Pixelates the picture and reduces its colours, for the look of an old computer game.

effects.name: Quadtree Zoom
effects.description: Splits the image into adaptive square blocks, small where detail is high and large in flat areas.

effects.name: Scatter Mosaic
effects.description: Breaks the image into tiles that sample from randomly jittered, drifting positions.

effects.name: Pixel Poster
effects.description: Pixelates the image into blocks and posterizes each to a few color levels.

effects.name: Pixel Sort
effects.description: Sorts short runs of pixels by brightness, so bright areas break into fine sideways streaks.

effects.name: Voronoi
effects.description: Shatters the image into slowly drifting Voronoi cells, each filled with one sampled color and subtly outlined.

effects.name: Halftone
effects.description: Prints the picture as a grid of round dots that grow in the dark parts, like a newspaper photo or a pop-art poster.

effects.name: Pattern Halftone
effects.description: Halftone screen of circle, diamond or line marks sized by image darkness, in Ink on Paper.

effects.name: Dithering
effects.description: Turns the picture into big pixels of a few flat colours in a checked pattern, like an early computer screen.

effects.name: Dither Studio
effects.description: Reduces the image to two ink colors using a selectable dither pattern.

effects.name: Riso
effects.description: Prints the picture in two inks of fine dots on cream paper, a little off register, like a risograph.

effects.name: Riso Glow
effects.description: Two-ink risograph print look with a pulsing glow added to the inks.

effects.name: Paper Print
effects.description: Maps brightness to a grainy two-color press print between Ink and Paper.

effects.name: Tone Geometry
effects.description: Replaces the image with a grid of squares, circles or triangles sized by darkness, in Ink on Paper.

effects.name: Crosshatch
effects.description: Renders tones as layered pen crosshatching with more line directions in darker areas, in Ink on Paper.

effects.name: Vector Engraving
effects.description: Redraws the image as rows of engraved wavy lines whose wave depth follows darkness, in Ink on Paper.

effects.name: Contour
effects.description: Draws iso-contour lines where brightness crosses Iso Level, in Line color on Paper.

effects.name: Contour Map
effects.description: Turns brightness into banded elevation zones between Ink and Paper with lines at each band, like a topographic map.

effects.name: Outline
effects.description: Turns the image into an edge drawing.

effects.name: Wave Lines
effects.description: Redraws the picture as wavy lines on a plain background, a graphic line-art look.

effects.name: Drift Lines
effects.description: Cuts the picture into thin bands that slide back and forth in a slow wave.

effects.name: Embroidery
effects.description: Covers the image in wavy animated thread rows tinted with the Ink color for a knitted fabric look.

effects.name: Kilim Carpet
effects.description: Overlays a woven diamond-and-stripe carpet pattern in two colors, shaded by image brightness.

effects.name: Cross Stitch
effects.description: Renders the image as X-shaped cross stitches on Paper-colored fabric.

effects.name: Stitch Poster
effects.description: Combines character art with cross-stitch X marks that get denser in dark areas over a paper-tinted background.

effects.name: ASCII
effects.description: Rebuilds the image from text characters chosen by brightness on a dark background.

effects.name: ASCII Ghost
effects.description: ASCII art whose characters cycle over time and leave fading ghost trails.

effects.name: Glyph Matrix
effects.description: Character art whose glyphs sweep diagonally through the character ramp over time, like a scrolling data wave.

effects.name: Symbol Matrix
effects.description: Symbol character art where each cell randomly swaps glyphs and pulses in brightness.

effects.name: Retro Matrix
effects.description: Scrolls amber monochrome terminal characters vertically with scanlines, like an old phosphor display.

effects.name: Matrix Rain
effects.description: Covers the image with falling green code characters with bright moving heads, like digital rain.

effects.name: Grid Glyph
effects.description: ASCII-style character art with a faint grid line drawn around every cell.

effects.name: Number Field
effects.description: Renders the image as a field of digits chosen by brightness, colored in five steps between Dark and Light.

effects.name: Pixel Code
effects.description: Replaces the image with random code characters tinted from deep blue to mint green by brightness.

effects.name: Word Mosaic
effects.description: Builds the image from rows of characters joined by thin connector strokes in brighter areas so they read like words.

effects.name: Inscribe
effects.description: Draws characters only along brightness edges over a darkened image, like text etched into the outlines.

effects.name: Dither Text
effects.description: Character art dithered with a checkerboard threshold and flickering noise so glyphs show mostly in brighter cells.

effects.name: Data Hatching
effects.description: Mixes cycling characters with diagonal hatching that thickens in darker areas.

effects.name: Dither Glow
effects.description: Renders glowing neon characters with soft cell halos, colored from Dark to Light by brightness.

effects.name: Contour Type
effects.description: Places numeric characters along brightness contour bands and edges, like a typographic topographic map.

effects.name: Brand Generator
effects.description: Block-glyph art whose characters shift in concentric rings around the center, framed by a border, for a logo-like pattern.

effects.name: Tag Pills
effects.description: Places each character inside a faint rounded pill, like a cloud of UI tags, with glyphs cycling over time.

effects.name: Creative UI Collage
effects.description: Turns the image into boxed UI-like cells with characters, borders and cursor dots that shuffle over time.

effects.name: Analog Signal Lab
effects.description: Sends the picture through a simulated PAL television chain: antenna, video tape and tube TV.

effects.name: CRT Screen
effects.description: Turns the picture into an old tube TV: glowing lines, fine red, green and blue stripes and a curved screen.

effects.name: Scanlines
effects.description: Lays fine horizontal lines over the picture, like an old TV or computer monitor.

effects.name: Film Grain
effects.description: Adds the fine, living texture of film.

effects.name: Glitch
effects.description: A broken digital signal: rows tear sideways, blocks jump and the colours split, in short bursts.

effects.name: Glitch Grid
effects.description: Randomly jumps grid cells sideways in flickering bursts for a blocky digital glitch.

effects.name: Ribbon Scan
effects.description: Rolls soft horizontal ribbons down the picture that push it sideways, like a wobbling video signal.

effects.name: Memory Leak
effects.description: Shows bytes the editor's video decoder left in memory as pixels: real data, not noise, for databending glitches.

effects.name: Chroma Key
effects.description: Makes a green or blue screen transparent, so the performer can stand in front of any background.

effects.name: Slit Scan
effects.description: Shows each part of the frame from a different moment, so movement smears and folds through the picture.

effects.name: Time Stack
effects.description: Shows delayed copies of a moving video clip at once, like a long-exposure photo of a dance.

effects.name: Motion Trails
effects.description: Leaves fading light trails behind moving content that drift with the tracked motion.

effects.name: Face Cables
effects.description: Ropes that hang between points of a face and swing with gravity, wind and every head movement, like cables plugged into the performer.

effects.name: Hand Particles
effects.description: Adds drifting glowing particles around tracked hands in the Overlay color.

effects.name: HUD Tracker
effects.description: Overlays a sci-fi HUD with a corner-bracket target box around the tracked subject.

effects.name: CCTV
effects.description: Turns footage into greenish monochrome security-camera video with scanlines, noise and a target box around the tracked subject.

effects.name: Subject Highlight
effects.description: Spotlights the tracked subject by keeping areas around face, body and hand landmarks bright while dimming the rest.

effects.name: Tracked Scene
effects.description: Draws tracked face landmarks as dots connected by lines in the Overlay color, like a motion-capture mesh.

effects.name: Stardust
effects.description: Scatters sparkling star particles in the Overlay color around the tracked landmarks, or a ring around the subject.

effects.name: Rain Reveal
effects.description: Pours falling streaks of the Overlay color over the scene.

effects.name: Voxel Relief
effects.description: Builds the picture out of small blocks in 3D: bright parts rise, dark parts stay low.

effects.name: Splat Exploration
effects.description: Stylizes a Gaussian splat clip by layering the splat with stretched light streaks, drifting particles and a wireframe surface mesh.

effects.name: Toy Bricks
effects.description: Rebuilds the image from staggered, beveled toy bricks, each filled with one color.

effects.name: Pixel Particle Disintegrate
effects.description: The picture breaks into small particles that blow away, as the clip's exit.

effects.name: Flocking
effects.description: A swarm in 3D (birds, fish, krill, sparks) that moves by itself around the clip, with real depth.

effects.name: Weave
effects.description: Woven fabric, yarn, ropes and knots, drawn as fine lit fibres in 3D above the clip.
